name: Hex Cellular Automaton
desc: A six-neighbor cyclic cellular automaton on a hexagonal honeycomb lattice that self-organizes from noise into rotating six-fold snowflake fronts and crystalline spiral waves tiling the whole frame, rendered as iridescent crystal rings, amber honeycomb, blue-white ice, radioactive green, or an etched hex engraving.

scale.doc: hex cell size / grid coarseness (higher = chunkier visible honeycomb, fewer cells)

density.doc: reseed cadence + nucleation richness (higher = more new fronts)

speed.doc: generations advanced per second (front rotation rate)

states.doc: number of color states N (cycle length / ring thickness)

hue.doc: base hue rotating the palette wheel

alpha.doc: opacity for VJ compositing (100 = opaque bg)
